Overview

Tournai is a city in Hainaut with a population of 69,000. One of Belgium’s oldest cities, known for its magnificent five-towered Romanesque cathedral, medieval bridge, and tapestry heritage. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
